subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu preserve omitted `allowBots` as accepting bot-authored messages by default, or should this PR make bot admission explicit or mention-only before merge?
rationale: The PR preserves current Feishu behavior but adds a new documented config surface and loop guard; changing the default would be safer but could be an upgrade behavior break, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Preserve Feishu Default Accept
options.body: Keep omitted `allowBots` accepting bot-authored messages for Feishu upgrades, with `allowBots: false`, `allowBots: "mentions"`, and loop protection documented as the controls.

options.title: Default To Mention-Only
options.body: Change the omitted Feishu default to accept bot-authored group messages only when the receiving bot is mentioned, aligning with a more conservative channel posture.

options.title: Require Explicit Bot Admission
options.body: Require operators to set `allowBots: true` or `"mentions"` before Feishu bot-authored events can dispatch, maximizing safety at the cost of breaking any current implicit bot-to-bot setups.

recommendation.title: Preserve Feishu Default Accept
recommendation.body: Keep omitted `allowBots` accepting bot-authored messages for Feishu upgrades, with `allowBots: false`, `allowBots: "mentions"`, and loop protection documented as the controls.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent Feishu mention/reply-dispatcher area contributor in the inspected path history and are tied to the same transport-policy surface.
